findings.title: The fail-closed allowlist permits substitution of unrelated maintenance history
findings.reproduction: MAINTENANCE_RECORD_PATH classifies every canonical GOV-MAINT record or review path as an allowed control path. In the existing real-Git fixture, first commit a distinct adopted planning/governance-migrations/GOV-MAINT-9999.json record, perform the approved UI implementation, and then call install_reviewed_maintenance for GOV-MAINT-0001 with mixed_product_path="planning/governance-migrations/GOV-MAINT-9999.json". The helper overwrites the unrelated adopted record with executable text, yet validate(root, base, head) returns ok=true with errors=[].
findings.requiredResolution: Bind allowed maintenance evidence paths to the selected maintenance record rather than the global GOV-MAINT filename grammar. Permit only that maintenanceId's canonical record and the exact review paths referenced by its authenticated reviewAttempts; deny any net semantic change to another maintenance record or review ledger. Add a real-Git regression that prepopulates a distinct adopted maintenance record, attempts to overwrite it through the reviewed route, and requires denial while retaining the legitimate same-maintenance control-only fixture.
